name: Bartter syndrome with hypocalcemia
description: Bartter syndrome with hypocalcemia is a type of Bartter syndrome characterized by hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia and hypoparathyroidism along with features of Henle's loop dysfunction (polyuria, hypokalemic alkalosis, increased levels of plasma renin and aldosterone, low blood pressure and vascular resistance to angiotensin II). Bartter syndrome with hypocalcemia is a very rare manifestation of autosomal dominant hypocalcemia (ADH)
